Retailer describes the herbal drink and its traditional herbal blend. The precise numeric intensities are editorial estimates, not laboratory measurements. Sweetened herbal flavor, with gentle earthy-floral notes. Scores have lower confidence: based on the product description rather than a controlled tasting of this US listing.

Product-specific customer tasting describes the drink as sweet and sour. This is customer evidence, not a controlled panel. Sweet dairy flavor with a tangy finish. Sourness is separate from astringency and is described here; texture and exact intensity vary with formulation.

Retailer identifies Coconut Palm ready-to-drink coconut milk with a smooth, lightly creamy consistency. The selected pack is 1 L cartons; numeric scores are an estimate of this product family. Coconut aroma with a smooth, lightly creamy mouthfeel. Sweetness is a conservative estimate for the ready-to-drink beverage, not canned cooking coconut milk.
Retailer describes the original candy as chewy and creamy. Sweet and creamy, with a soft, chewy texture. This row covers the original milk candy in the bundle.

Retailer identifies the matcha variant as creamy, chewy green-tea milk candy. Sweet milk-candy base with a green-tea note and chewy texture. Tea bitterness and dryness are conservative estimates; this is the matcha half of the bundle.

Firsthand review reports peanut and chili notes, bitterness 2/5, umami 2/5, no sweetness, low heat and a numbing sensation. One firsthand reviewer found mild heat and some bitterness; heat tolerance and batches can differ.
